scientific_integrity: A symbolic incidence proof is given; standalone exhaustive checks over fields of orders 2, 3, 4 and 5 corroborate but do not substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: No claim about other dimension-four types or higher-dimensional filiform Lie algebras. Published subalgebra classification is credited. Searches cannot rule out an older equivalent result in group-theoretic literature.
scientific_scope: The four-dimensional nilpotent Lie algebra with [x,y]=z and [x,z]=w over any finite field F_q; all Lie subalgebras including 0 and L; ordered pairs.
title: Dimension-refined permutability of the four-dimensional filiform Lie algebra
